changelog:
Initial release of ebay-search-listing:

- Extracts product listings from any eBay search or category page URL across all regional eBay domains.
- Provides per-item details including item number, URL, title, price, subtitle, caption, shipping, seller info, ratings, and image.
- Returns pagination state: current page, next page URL, has next page, and approximate total results.
- Handles both search result and category URLs, supporting paginated bulk extraction.
- Outputs data in the user's language and requires no login for public pages.
- Designed for quick extraction, price comparison, competitive monitoring, and category catalog audits.
summary: Extracts product listings from any eBay search or category page URL, returning per-item cards (itemNumber, url, title, subtitle, caption, price, priceWithCurrency, currency, wasPrice, bids, shipping, seller, sellerFeedbackCount, sellerPositiveRating, reviewsCount, starRating, image) plus pagination
